strategy.title: Prioritize BEST Visa Companies First
strategy.description: 3 companies offer BEST visa sponsorship: Cara Care (score 92, remote-first, Bayer-backed), Audatic (score 91, explicit immigration support, only 36 applicants), and Jobgether (score 88, fully remote, <25 applicants). Apply to all three today — these are the strongest visa + match combinations in the entire dataset.

strategy.title: Speed-Apply to Fresh Postings
strategy.description: Audatic was posted 7 hours ago (36 applicants), Jobgether 15 hours ago (<25 applicants), Flix ~2 days ago. Early applications to low-competition postings significantly improve callback rates. These three have the best freshness-to-competition ratio.

strategy.title: Target Berlin Companies for On-Site Advantage
strategy.description: 15 of 28 processed jobs are in Berlin. Concentrate applications there: Cara Care, Audatic, Sunday Natural, lemon.markets, Parloa, Scope Ratings, Lumenaza. Berlin location removes relocation friction and strengthens candidacy for on-site roles.

strategy.title: Lead with Python/Django/FastAPI Stack Evidence
strategy.description: Python appears in 25 of 28 jobs. FastAPI in 12+, Django in 4+, PostgreSQL in 13+. Frame applications around concrete project experience: 5K TPM transaction system (Django/PostgreSQL/Redis), invoice microservice (3x faster), 9+ years Python. This stack is the single strongest differentiator.

strategy.title: Avoid German-Required Roles
strategy.description: Two otherwise strong fits are blocked by German language: suena energy (score 45, needs C1) and EnopAI (score 50, needs B2/C1). Do not invest time in these until German reaches B2. Focus on English-only roles instead.

strategy.title: Apply to Remote-First Roles for Immediate Start
strategy.description: Cara Care (remote-first, work from anywhere initially), Jobgether (fully remote), and Ebury (remote/hybrid across Europe) allow starting from Iran without relocation pressure. These provide the fastest path to employment while visa processes complete.

strengths.name: Python (9+ years)
strengths.detail: Core requirement in 25 of 28 jobs. Hassan's 9+ years exceeds most requirements (typically 5-7 years). Mentioned in every high-match role.

strengths.name: Django/DRF
strengths.detail: Perfect match for Cara Care (score 92), Sunday Natural (score 82), Lumenaza (score 72). Django appears in 4 job listings with direct stack alignment.

strengths.name: FastAPI
strengths.detail: Appears in 12+ job listings: Audatic, Engelhart, lemon.markets, WorkGenius, Parloa, Cirql One, exmox, Venture Up, The Exploration Company, EnopAI. Most in-demand framework in the dataset.

strengths.name: PostgreSQL
strengths.detail: Required or preferred in 13+ jobs. Hassan's expertise aligns with Cara Care, lemon.markets, Lumenaza, Scope Ratings, ARX Robotics, and others.

strengths.name: Docker/Kubernetes
strengths.detail: Appears in 10+ listings. Production containerization experience matches Cara Care (K8s), Parloa (K8s), exmox (K8s), ARX Robotics (K8s).

strengths.name: AWS/GCP Cloud Experience
strengths.detail: Cloud infrastructure appears in 8+ jobs. GCP match for Cara Care, AWS for Engelhart, Flix, lemon.markets, WorkGenius, Mobility House.

strengths.name: AI/ML Background (M.Sc.)
strengths.detail: Differentiator for Audatic (speech enhancement AI), Mindpeak (digital pathology ML), Jobgether (AI/ML developer tools), Parloa (conversational AI). M.Sc. AI is rare among backend applicants.

weaknesses.name: TypeScript/Node.js
weaknesses.detail: Required or preferred in Parloa (primary language), ARX Robotics (Node.js), The Exploration Company (Node.js/Hocuspocus), Mobility House (TypeScript). 4 high-match roles list this as a gap.

weaknesses.name: German Language (A2 level)
weaknesses.detail: Blocks suena energy (needs C1) and EnopAI (needs B2/C1 negotiation level). May also limit non-explicit requirements at other German-headquartered companies.

weaknesses.name: Go Programming Language
weaknesses.detail: Co-primary in Cresta, GALVANY, and ARX Robotics. 3 jobs require or prefer Go — a gap that cannot be filled quickly.

weaknesses.name: Domain Knowledge Gaps
weaknesses.detail: Energy trading (suena, Engelhart), aerospace/space (Exploration Company, ARX Robotics), healthcare regulation (Cara Care — though transferable). New domains require ramp-up time.

weaknesses.name: AWS vs GCP Imbalance
weaknesses.detail: Most jobs prefer AWS (8+ listings). Hassan has stronger GCP experience from Cara Care match. AWS-focused roles may require upskilling.
